title: Limitmc
description: A Minecraft network with unique and fun game modes.
body:
## 🌐 LimitMC

A Minecraft network with unique and fun game modes:

⚒️ **LimitDupe**
A survival server with `/shop` and an economy system.

🎲 **RandomKit**
Every time you die, you respawn with a completely random kit.

Adapt, survive, and see what luck gives you!

✨ More game modes coming soon!

**IP:** `play.limitmc.net`
